scenes.role: Essential opening: Nia asks rather than taking the neighbour’s peg bag.
prerequisites: The washing is waiting and Mae is present.
actions: Ask Mae to borrow the peg bag.
consequences: The bag changes custody and can be used for the laundry.
prose_obligations: Make Nia’s wish to help and Mae’s boundary about returning the bag legible.

scenes.role: Essential weather observation that starts the limited work window.
scenes.location: Shared garden, by the washing line
prerequisites: Nia has borrowed the bag.
actions: Notice the cloud bank and advancing shower.
consequences: Weather knowledge and elapsed time persist into the work scenes.
prose_obligations: Keep the shower approaching rather than pretending it has already rained.

scenes.role: Optional vignette showing care when a small delay is tempting.
prerequisites: The bag is borrowed; washing preparation has not begun.
actions: Move a snail away from a puddle to the marigolds.
consequences: The snail’s safe location persists and may be recalled at the ending.
prose_obligations: Do not imply the vignette occurred if it was omitted.

scenes.role: Optional neighbour-and-child characterization.
prerequisites: The bag is borrowed; preparation has not begun.
actions: Mae shares a short rhyme about checking sheet corners.
consequences: Nia remembers the rhyme and Mae’s trust increases.
prose_obligations: The rhyme must be spoken here before any later callback.

scenes.role: Preparation encounter; consolidated with sorting and the priority choice.
prerequisites: Weather has been noticed.
actions: Check the line and arrange the washing for the available pegs.
consequences: The line is prepared and the priority choice becomes persistent state.
prose_obligations: Explain the ordinary reason a heavy sheet may be unsuitable for a weak line.

scenes.role: Reference beat consolidated into preparation rather than a separate executable scene.
prerequisites: The weather window is known.
actions: Identify the sheet, shirt, towel, and socks.
consequences: No separate event is executed; preparation prose and state carry the useful setup.
prose_obligations: Do not claim a garment moved before the hanging actions.

scenes.role: Consequential choice consolidated into the preparation and hanging scenes.
prerequisites: The peg count and sheet requirements are known.
actions: Choose sheet-first or smaller-items-first when pegs are scarce.
consequences: With limited pegs, the choice changes which garments reach the line.
prose_obligations: Do not describe the unchosen allocation as completed.

scenes.role: Part of the essential hanging pass; the sheet needs more clips in wind or when heavy.
prerequisites: Preparation is complete and enough pegs remain.
actions: Clip the sheet if the line can bear it and the required pegs are available.
consequences: The sheet’s location and peg use are recorded.
prose_obligations: Only say the sheet is on the line if the action succeeded.

scenes.role: Part of the same short hanging pass, not a separately selectable scene.
prerequisites: Enough pegs remain for the shirt.
actions: Hang the shirt.
consequences: The shirt’s location and peg use persist.
prose_obligations: Render only garments actually placed on the line.

scenes.role: Consolidated small-garment actions in the hanging pass.
prerequisites: Pegs remain for each item.
actions: Clip the towel and pair of socks where resources allow.
consequences: Each garment’s location is independent, allowing partial progress.
prose_obligations: Leave unpegged items in the basket until a later enacted action moves them.

scenes.role: Complication resolved in the weather-turn scene.
prerequisites: The hanging pass has finished.
actions: Notice the wind and advancing shower.
consequences: Weather advances; the safe-line check determines the next choice.
prose_obligations: A gust cannot remove a garment unless a local action changes its location.

scenes.role: The consequential response is selected from the enacted line, rain, and shelter conditions.
prerequisites: The weather turn has been observed.
actions: Leave a secure full line, use the covered rack, or gather the load as rain arrives.
consequences: The selected plan determines the protection scene and eligible ending.
prose_obligations: Do not narrate a rescue plan that the parameterized world disallows.

scenes.role: Alternative protection encounter when the shed is available.
prerequisites: The weather turn selects shelter and the shelter is open.
actions: Move all garments to the sheltered rack, keeping any clips already in use.
consequences: All washing is under cover; this supports the shelter ending.
prose_obligations: Distinguish a sheltered rack from a completed sunny-line deadline.

scenes.role: Alternative protection encounter when no shed is available.
prerequisites: The weather turn selects gathering; rain may arrive during the action.
actions: Gather every garment, recover the borrowed pegs, and put the washing in the basket.
consequences: The shower is recorded and the later ending must enact an indoor rehang.
prose_obligations: Acknowledge the missed deadline without leaving the story emotionally unfinished.

scenes.role: Successful alternative consolidated into protection when everything is secure and rain has not begun.
prerequisites: All garments are on a strong, secure line and the shower has not arrived.
actions: Check the line rather than moving it unnecessarily.
consequences: The wash is marked ready for the dry-line ending.
prose_obligations: Do not call an unstable or partial line secure.

scenes.role: Essential closing action consolidated into each ending.
prerequisites: Protection or successful hanging has been resolved.
actions: Return the peg bag after using its pegs for the neighbour’s washing.
consequences: Custody returns to Mae; the bag’s useful work is explicit.
prose_obligations: Do not equate returning custody with having used the object helpfully.

scenes.role: Earned successful ending for a complete secure line.
prerequisites: All garments are securely on the line and rain has not begun.
actions: Return the bag and acknowledge the completed deadline.
consequences: The story ends with the wash hung before the shower.
prose_obligations: The ending must be grounded in the safe-line and weather state.

scenes.role: Alternate complete ending when the covered rack is available.
prerequisites: The washing has been moved to the open covered rack.
actions: Finish securing the sheltered washing and return the bag.
consequences: The original sunny-line deadline is missed, but the clothes are safe.
prose_obligations: Give the outcome closure rather than leaving only a future intention.

scenes.role: Emotionally complete recovery ending when no shelter is available.
prerequisites: Rain has caught the gathered laundry and the basket is ready.
actions: Tell Mae the truth, rehang the wash indoors with her, and return the peg bag.
consequences: The deadline is missed but recovery is completed and the neighbour’s trust is maintained.
prose_obligations: Do not end with an unanswered promise to fix the laundry later.

scenes.role: Reference-story character beat represented by the child’s enacted rescue choice and ending prose.
prerequisites: The child recognizes the line or weather problem.
actions: Ask Mae for the help her uninjured hand can provide.
consequences: The authored reference resolves this beat in prose; executable variants keep the choice within the protect action.
prose_obligations: Do not claim an extra handoff or physical assistance in a route that has not narrated it.

scenes.role: Reference-story closing beat not represented as a separate executable scene.
prerequisites: The neighbour’s washing has reached a completed ending.
actions: Answer Mum’s call and return to the cups.
consequences: Not required for the seven/eight-scene objective; no hidden home action runs when omitted.
prose_obligations: Do not imply the child finished home chores in generated episodes.

scenes.role: Reference-story reflection consolidated into the ending outcome.
prerequisites: The child has experienced the actual result of the weather choice.
actions: Distinguish the hoped-for deadline from the repair that was actually completed.
consequences: Dry-line, shelter, and rain-recovery outcomes remain distinct.
prose_obligations: Never claim a future sunny-day chore has already occurred.
